aiResearchSummary.text: Sixfold Bioscience is researching compositions containing oligonucleotides with theranostic applications and compositions containing nucleic acid nanoparticles with modular functionality. These therapeutic compositions use nucleic acid nanostructures to deliver cargo molecules and improve their function in the body for combined therapeutic and diagnostic use. Overall, the work focuses on theranostic nucleic acid nanostructures, modular nucleic acid nanoparticles, and cargo delivery systems.
